description: The first run and "Add a server…": the servers this app opens, what discovery found, the link waiting, choosing a server (the main window opens there), and running agentes.chat on this computer (setting it up and cancelling it, Tailscale's state for reach), and pairing this computer with a workspace once the person confirms here (a pair link's maker and workspace from its server, a new home, its code confirmed with the main window's session, open at login), and then this Mac's permissions (their state, the system's prompts, System Settings) with the setup kept until it ends, so it comes back when macOS quits the app for Screen Recording.
